title: The record
body: 108 consecutive 4.167-mile yards at Big’s Backyard Ultra, October 2023 — a world record that stood until 2025. In 2025, he pushed further to 111 yards (462.5 miles).

title: Badwater veteran
body: 15 finishes across Death Valley with two outright victories (2014, 2021). In 2024, he completed the 270-mile Badwater Double, turning around and running back to the start.

title: Chasing Democracy
body: 250 miles on foot from NYC to the U.S. Capitol for America's 250th anniversary in 2026, running to spotlight the community stories that built our democracy.

title: School days a year
body: He teaches full time in Cincinnati Public Schools and run-commutes three miles each way, adding five more on the way home.
